title: Where facts wait until they are verified
ask: Where should the facts that are not yet verified wait: a new 00-verify project with every project renumbered, a 03-verify project with no renumbering, or inside the project that needs each one?
why:
Your brief (4.5) says: anything not a backed fact stays out of the Manual and waits in a new project called 00-verify, with every other project's number moved up by one. The Manual now works out on its own what is held back: anything still marked "confirm", a spec marked unverified, or a figure from another model year's manual. So the only open question is where the work to verify those facts lives.

Renumbering costs more than it looks. Every block id carries its project's number (00.29 is electrical's 29th block), and so does every gate and cross-project link that names one. Moving 00-electrical to 01 rewrites hundreds of ids across the tree and in the history, and an old id like 00.29 in a past commit would then point at the wrong project.
options:
(a) A new project 00-verify, as you wrote it, and every project moves up one number (electrical becomes 01, luxury 02 …). Costs a one-time rewrite of every block id and gate; old ids in past commits and decisions stop matching.
(b) A new project 03-verify, the next free number, and nothing else is renumbered. Same list, same work; it just sorts after the engine project.
(c) No verify project. Each project keeps its own unknowns now (your "future" state from 4.5), and 00-CAR's held-back facts become work rows in the project that needs them.
recommend: (b), unless the 00 at the top of the list matters more to you than keeping every existing id stable.
stops: Only the verify list's home. The Manual itself is built either way; what is held back is computed, not moved.
